paper_title: A Controllable Examination for Long-Context Language Models
caption: The bar chart of performance by different attributes on the 2-retrieval task. For simplicity, we abbreviate the names of all instruct models.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of a multi-retrieval task across several attributes. The horizontal axis displays four distinct model names: Qwen2.5-7b, Internlm3-8b, ProLong-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b, presented in a rotated orientation. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled "Accuracy," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, and tick labels every 20 units. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group representing a model, and each bar within a group representing a different attribute. The attributes are city (light green), hobby (red), university (purple), major (pink), and birthdate (yellow-green), identified by a legend at the top right of the chart. The tallest bar, representing the 'hobby' attribute for the Internlm3-8b model, reaches approximately 78 on the accuracy scale, while the shortest bar, for 'birthdate' under Qwen2.5-7b, is approximately 10. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there are no visually emphasized bars.
